data.name: DayMonthFormat
data.comment: NOT TEXT: a .NET date pattern for a day and month without the year or weekday, like 6 Nov. d is the day, MMM the short month name.

data.name: SuppliesOrders
data.comment: Row on the Supplies page that opens the list of orders.

data.name: SuppliesOrdersNone
data.value: Plants you've bought, until they arrive
data.comment: Line under Orders on the Supplies page when none are on the way.

data.name: SuppliesOrdersOnTheWay
data.comment: Line under Orders on the Supplies page. {0} is how many orders are on the way.

data.name: ListPageTitle
data.comment: Title of the Orders page in the browser tab.

data.name: ListTitle
data.comment: Heading of the Orders page.

data.name: ListIntro
data.value: Plants you've bought, until the box arrives.
data.comment: One line under the heading of the Orders page.

data.name: ListNew
data.comment: Button that starts a new order.

data.name: ListEmpty
data.value: Keep track of plants you've bought until they arrive. When the box comes, unpack it and each plant is added for you.
data.comment: Shown on the Orders page when there are no orders.

data.name: GroupOnTheWay
data.comment: Heading over the orders that haven't arrived.

data.name: GroupArrived
data.comment: Heading over the orders that have arrived.

data.name: MetaExpected
data.comment: Line under an order on the list. {0} is the number of plants, like 5 plants, {1} the expected day, like Thu 6 Nov.

data.name: MetaOrdered
data.comment: Line under an order on the list with no expected day. {0} is the number of plants, {1} the day it was ordered, like 1 Nov.

data.name: MetaArrived
data.comment: Line under an order that arrived and everything came. {0} is the day, like 3 Nov, {1} the number of plants.

data.name: MetaArrivedSome
data.comment: Line under an order that arrived with something missing. {0} is the day, {1} how many came, {2} how many were ordered.

data.name: DetailPageTitle
data.comment: Title of an order's page in the browser tab. {0} is the seller.

data.name: DetailTitle
data.comment: Heading of an order's page. {0} is the seller's name, which is a link.

data.name: DetailBack
data.comment: Link back to the list of orders.

data.name: DetailMissing
data.value: That order isn't here any more.
data.comment: Shown when an order can't be found.

data.name: DetailOrdered
data.comment: Line under the heading of an order. {0} is the day, like 1 Nov.

data.name: DetailOrderedExpected
data.comment: Line under the heading of an order on the way. {0} is the day it was ordered, {1} the expected day, like Thu 6 Nov.

data.name: DetailOrderedArrived
data.comment: Line under the heading of an order that arrived. {0} is the day it was ordered, {1} the day it arrived.

data.name: Unpack

data.name: StateOnTheWay
data.comment: Under an item on an order that hasn't arrived.

data.comment: Under an item on an order that was bought for a wish.

data.comment: Under an item that became a cutting which has since been deleted.

data.name: DidNotCome

data.name: TotalPlants
data.comment: Label for the sum of the prices on an order.

data.name: TotalShipping
data.comment: Label for what shipping cost on an order.

data.name: TotalTotal
data.comment: Label for the plants and the shipping added together.

data.name: ShippingEach
data.comment: Small line under the totals of an order. {0} is the amount.

data.comment: Label of the day the order is expected.

data.comment: Placeholder of the name of an item on the order form.

data.comment: Button on the order form that adds an empty row for another item.

data.comment: Button on the order form that adds a plant already in the app to the order.

data.comment: Label of the choice of a plant to add to the order.

data.name: FormDelete
data.comment: Button at the bottom of the form for changing an order.

data.name: FormDeleteConfirm

data.name: FormSaveError
data.comment: Error when saving an order fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: FormDeleteError
data.comment: Error when deleting an order fails. {0} is the reason.

data.comment: Label of the day the box arrived.

data.comment: Choice for an unpacked item: it becomes a cutting.

data.name: UnpackTidy

data.name: UnpackStays

data.name: UnpackPutIn

data.name: UnpackButton_Other
data.comment: Button that unpacks the ticked items. {0} is the number.

data.name: UnpackError
data.comment: Error when unpacking fails. {0} is the reason.

data.comment: Shown on a seller's page when there are no orders.
